invariants.statement: Source media is never modified or deleted by extraction repair rollback or cleanup.
A reported completed artifact exists validates and has recorded provenance.
Readers see a committed generation and partial output never appears complete.
Expiry never deletes a workspace held by an active reader or writer.
Cooperating processes using one root cannot bypass its admission limit.
Every loop queue output retry extraction request and download is bounded.
Untrusted evidence cannot select executables install dependencies or change policy.
Optional enrichment failure preserves useful evidence and reports missing coverage.
Durable acknowledgement follows the applicable storage commit.
Unsupported required guarantees fail closed and supported controls are reported.
